info.cls_ename: Bachelor's Program of International Business Administration in English

description.describe_ch: 面對多樣全球金融市場架構下如何進行國際投資之相關議題，包含下列議題介紹：1. 外匯市場與國際評價條件、2. 國際金融市場及3. 國際投資模型與應用。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to introduces the issues of international investments under the global framework of international financial markets, including foreign exchange market and international parity condition, political risk, tax, international debt and equity markets, and international portfolio choices. Students are expected to take actions to identify international investment decisions through potential channels.

targets.describe_ch: 認識外匯市場與國際金融市場
targets.describe_en: To understand the foreign exchange market and the international financial markets
